bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for a grant to Wallin Education Partners to support college admission and graduation programming for low-income students; requiring a report.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; WALLIN EDUCATION PARTNERS. +]

[+(a) $500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of higher education for immediate transfer to Wallin Education Partners to support programming focused on college admission and college graduation for low-income students, including financial aid, advising, and career development. +]

[+(b) This appropriation must be used by Wallin Education Partners only for programs supporting students who are residents of Minnesota and attending colleges or universities within Minnesota. +]

[+(c) By February 1 each fiscal year that Wallin Education Partners receives an appropriation, Wallin Education Partners must report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees and divisions with jurisdiction over higher education and early childhood through grade 12 education on activities funded by this appropriation. The report must include but is not limited to information about the demographics of students served, the colleges and universities in Minnesota attended by students served, the high schools attended by students served, and the geographic distribution of the students served. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for a grant to Wallin Education Partners to support college admission and graduation programming for low-income students; requiring a report.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; WALLIN EDUCATION PARTNERS.

(a) $500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of higher education for immediate transfer to Wallin Education Partners to support programming focused on college admission and college graduation for low-income students, including financial aid, advising, and career development.

(b) This appropriation must be used by Wallin Education Partners only for programs supporting students who are residents of Minnesota and attending colleges or universities within Minnesota.

(c) By February 1 each fiscal year that Wallin Education Partners receives an appropriation, Wallin Education Partners must report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees and divisions with jurisdiction over higher education and early childhood through grade 12 education on activities funded by this appropriation. The report must include but is not limited to information about the demographics of students served, the colleges and universities in Minnesota attended by students served, the high schools attended by students served, and the geographic distribution of the students served.
additions: (a) $500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of higher education for immediate transfer to Wallin Education Partners to support programming focused on college admission and college graduation for low-income students, including financial aid, advising, and career development.
(b) This appropriation must be used by Wallin Education Partners only for programs supporting students who are residents of Minnesota and attending colleges or universities within Minnesota.

(c) By February 1 each fiscal year that Wallin Education Partners receives an appropriation, Wallin Education Partners must report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees and divisions with jurisdiction over higher education and early childhood through grade 12 education on activities funded by this appropriation. The report must include but is not limited to information about the demographics of students served, the colleges and universities in Minnesota attended by students served, the high schools attended by students served, and the geographic distribution of the students served.
